company.notes: Alphabet Inc. became the holding company of Google Inc. (CIK 0001288776) on 2015-10-02; Google directors became Alphabet directors and their Google service carries over. Google Inc. was incorporated in California in September 1998 and reincorporated in Delaware in August 2003. IPO priced 2004-08-18 ($85.00, auction), first trade 2004-08-19 on Nasdaq as GOOG (Class A). On 2014-04-02 Class C capital stock was distributed as a dividend to Class A and Class B holders (described as a two-for-one split effected as a stock dividend); from 2014-04-03 Class A trades as GOOGL and Class C as GOOG, which matters for Class A total-return calculations. 20-for-one split: record 2022-07-01, distributed after close 2022-07-15, split-adjusted trading from 2022-07-18 (as announced). Class B carries ten votes per share. Board is not classified: all directors are elected annually.

conflicts.description: Mulally's departure day. The 2022 proxy says his term 'will end at the Annual Meeting', and the Item 5.07 8-K says that meeting was held on 2022-06-01. The 2023 proxy twice says he served 'until June 2, 2022' (the same proxy says Washington joined the Audit Committee on June 1, 2022). Recorded 2022-06-01 per the annual-meeting rule.

Brin as Chairman. The 2015 8-K12B and 2026 proxy say Brin was 'President and Chairman' of Google's board from September 1998 to July 2001. The IPO prospectus calls him only President for that period, and says Eric Schmidt was Chairman from March 2001 to April 2004, which overlaps March-July 2001. Recorded the chair span as stated in the later filings at medium confidence.
Pichai's CEO start day. The 8-K cover gives 2019-12-02 as the date of earliest event; the 8-K body and press release announce the change on 2019-12-03 'effective immediately'. Recorded 2019-12-03.

open_questions: Pre-IPO start days are not disclosed: Page, Brin and Shriram (September 1998), Doerr (May 1999), Hennessy (April 2004) are month-precision. An EDGAR full-text search ('Hennessy' + 'April 2004', Google filings 2004-2006) returned the S-1/424B4 family and proxies; the S-1 and 424B4 give only the month.
Hennessy's Lead Independent Director start is disclosed only as April 2007 and its end as January 2018 (he became Chair 2018-01-31).
Page's 2011 CEO start uses the effective date announced in the 2011-01-20 8-K (April 4, 2011); later filings say only 'April 2011'.

Brin's employment titles between April 2011 and May 2011 are not stated (2015 8-K12B: President, Technology to April 2011; 2026 proxy: President from May 2011). His employee-director span is recorded as continuous at medium confidence.

Independence spans are aligned to board tenure from point-in-time determinations (every 2020-2026 proxy excludes only Page, Brin and Pichai). Earlier Google-era determinations were not reviewed individually.
Authorized board size is never stated after the IPO prospectus (nine). Size changes are recorded from the director counts in proxies ('currently composed of') and appointments/departures.
Arnold's Illumina seat was scheduled to end on 2026-05-21 per the 2026 proxy; kept as 'current' because that is how the proxy lists it, and Illumina's own filings were not checked.
Other-board lists come from Alphabet's own bios and 8-Ks, not from the other issuers' filings. 2026 proxy entries give no years; years shown come from the directors' appointment 8-Ks where available.
Committee assignments are point-in-time from the 2026 proxy (current board) and the 2022/2023 proxies (Mulally, Mather). Committee history between proxies is not captured.

coverage.method: Roster from the 2026 DEF 14A (ten nominees) and the 2026-06-11 Item 5.07 8-K (all ten elected 2026-06-05); every 8-K with Item 5.02 filed after the proxy (2026-06-05, 2026-06-11) reviewed (PAO appointment; stock-plan amendment with the Item 5.07 results); every Form 3 filed in 2026 checked (none for a director); Forms 4 filed July-Sept 2026 show nine of the ten as directors. Submissions feed fetched 2026-10-04, latest filing 2026-10-02.

Every Alphabet DEF 14A 2020-2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 filed 2019-12-01 to 2026-10-02 reviewed; Forms 3 2016-2026 checked. Departures since 2020: Mulally (2022-06-01) and Mather (2023-10-31) only.

Start dates of directors still serving (or serving into 2020) taken from the Google IPO prospectus, Google/Alphabet 8-Ks and proxies. Departures before 2020 (e.g. Schmidt, Greene, Tilghman, Otellini, Moritz, Levinson) were out of scope and are not recorded.
